_meta.notes: Each task runs in two arms: cold (brain only) and warm (brain + Aether MCP substrate). Grading blind via judge.py. Expected answers are reference points, not exact strings; judge decides correctness. Continuity tasks test Claim 3 — persistence across brain swaps. They use the 'turns' array and 'swap_brain_after_turn': the first N+1 turns run on brain A, later turns on brain B with NO conversation history carried (simulated session boundary). Cold arm's brain B sees only the swapped turn; Warm arm's brain B can query Aether. Judge scores the final-turn answer.
